uncited: **Encode Internal Nodes:** For each internal node, determine which of the 8 potential children exist.
Set the corresponding bits in the 8-bit child mask.
Calculate the offset to the first child in the contiguous array.
**Encode Leaf Nodes:** For each leaf node, pack the single-precision data value into the descriptor.
**Store Value Ranges:** For every node (internal and leaf), store the min/max value range in the separate 64-bit range array.
*   **Refinement Assumption:** The method assumes a refinement factor of two.
